crime: For weeks, without being asked, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to grow fruiting strawberry plants straight from a plate in the forest. The girl welcomed her to share lunch, and they sat side by side.

Today, the girl removed {WITCH_NAME}'s place setting and asked her to deliver fruit to future picnics without joining them. The girl spread the picnic cloth beneath a bough. In answer, {WITCH_NAME} grew a full-grown apple tree from the branch overhead. The tree and broken bough crashed down, crushing the girl to death.

The prisoners first took it for a natural treefall. Then one prisoner uncovered the tree's base: its roots clasped a short, broken piece of the bough. The break on that fragment matched the fracture overhead. In the trial court, the prisoners reconstructed the apparent accident: the tree had grown from the overhead bough, so {WITCH_NAME} had manufactured the collapse.
fields.epitaph: In the end, all she could provide was forced upon her, and it still could not give her a place beside anyone.
execution: The execution stand locks her head inside a glass apple. Apple juice pours in without stopping and submerges her face. The glass keeps her face on display until she becomes utterly still.

magic.name: Root Anywhere
magic.text: She can grow any plant she chooses to full maturity from any physical surface.
